I diagnosed the incident and wrote the complete, self-contained solution to **`~/QA-BUNKER-26-solution.md`**.

## What it is

**Root cause:** In `~/.hermes/scripts/bunker-qa.sh` the **detection ladder** and the **venv+pytest provisioning bootstrap** are two independent "is this a Python repo?" conditions. QA-BUNKER-24 extended detection to `pytest.ini`/`conftest.py`, but the bootstrap still armed only under `pyproject.toml`. A `pytest.ini`-only repo is therefore selected for `python3 -m pytest` but never gets a runner — on a fresh JIT agent (stdlib-only `python3`, venv bin not on PATH) every suite leg dies `No module named pytest`. Harness row `QA-BUNKER-26`; **not** a product row.

**Exact fix** (generated-remote bootstrap guard):

```diff
-# python venv + pytest bootstrap (arms only for pyproject.toml repos)
-if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then
+# QA-BUNKER-26: arm for every shape the detection ladder selects.
+if [ -f pyproject.toml ] || [ -f pytest.ini ] || [ -f conftest.py ] || [ -f tests/conftest.py ]; then
```

with the existing fresh-creation + best-effort top-up (`|| true`) body unchanged, plus a recommended shared `python_repo_shape()` predicate so the two halves can never drift again.

**Verification I actually ran** (in the markdown, with real output):
- Local control: auger `py_compile` OK, `ruff` clean, `218 tests collected`.
- A self-contained fresh-agent repro that builds a real stdlib-only venv: **pre-fix `rc=1` → `UNVERIFIED`** (`No module named pytest`), **post-fix `rc=0` → `OK`** (`1 passed`).
- Classifier battery and generated-bytes regression test, plus the fresh-agent acceptance run.

Grade rule is preserved throughout: runner-missing native legs are `UNVERIFIED` ("suite NEVER RAN, no repo signal"), never `FAIL`, never `OK`.

signatures.description: Symptom: a QA battery cell (chaos-resource or the ci-pass native leg) on a fresh JIT clean machine shows the only suite output as 'No module named pytest' (or another runner-missing signature) while the repo is green on the dev box. Diagnosis procedure: (1) Read the per-cell log on the agent (res.log / native.log over the per-agent ssh key) BEFORE destroying the agent - the evidence detail truncates; the log names the exact runner and rc. (2) Run the local control: full unfiltered suite at HEAD on the dev box; rc=0 means clean-machine environment class, not repo brittleness. (3) Check the harness runner-provisioning chain: the venv+pytest bootstrap in bunker-qa.sh arms only under pyproject.toml, so pytest.ini/conftest.py-only repos (the detection-ladder branch added for QA-BUNKER-24) get selected for pytest but never provisioned - the runner is missing by construction, not by accident. (4) Grade: runner-missing native legs are UNVERIFIED ('suite NEVER RAN, no repo signal'), never FAIL and never OK; the fix belongs to the harness (extend the bootstrap trigger to the same condition the detection ladder added), file a harness row, do NOT file a product row. Root cause this instance: detection extended to a new repo shape without adding the runner provisioning to the same bootstrap in the same commit. Fix shape: extend the venv+pytest bootstrap trigger to the same pytest.ini/conftest.py condition the detection ladder added (fresh creation plus best-effort top-up). Verification: local control green at HEAD; agent log names the missing runner; harness row QA-BUNKER-26 filed with the repro.
